notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired coat-closet and laundry-closet doors were counted separately; their rapid closing order and exact midpoints are somewhat ambiguous. Survey-only movement and automatic refrigerator lighting were not counted as interactions.
scene_description: A user surveys an apartment entry hallway, opens and inspects a two-door coat closet, opens and inspects a two-door laundry closet, then interacts with a built-in refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer before surveying the living and work areas.
